method: fastPLS SIMPLS-LDA on CellPhenotyper virtual-marker scores
claim_limit: Virtual-marker scores are not measured protein abundance; this is research cell-type prediction. Corrected-RGB exploratory score includes GigaTIME nuclear-QC failures; it is not validated cell-typing performance.

test_image_class_coverage.interpretation: Only images with at least two expert reference classes contribute to the multiclass image-average scores. Classes with fewer than five expert cells are excluded from the sensitivity score. Single-class images remain visible but have no multiclass score. The score is conditional on expert nuclear masks, and does not assess cell detection.
